intro.en: Thabit asks Harith why he left Iraq and how he likes Jeddah. Notice the question words لِماذا (why), كَيْفَ (how), كَمْ (how long) and إِلى أَيْنَ (to where).
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein Thabit, Harith se poochta hai ke usne Iraq kyun chhora aur Jeddah kaisa lagta hai. Sawali alfaaz dhyan se dekhein: لِماذا (kyun), كَيْفَ (kaise), كَمْ (kitna) aur إِلى أَيْنَ (kahan ki taraf).
intro.ar: يَسْأَلُ ثابِتٌ الحارِثَ: لِماذا تَرَكْتَ العِراقَ؟ وَكَيْفَ تَجِدُ جُدَّةَ؟ تَعَلَّمْ أَدَواتِ الاسْتِفْهامِ: لِماذا، كَيْفَ، كَمْ، إِلى أَيْنَ.

dialogue.en: Why did you leave Iraq?
dialogue.ur: Aapne Iraq kyun chhora?

dialogue.ar: اِنْتَقَلَتِ الشَّرِكَةُ إِلى جُدَّةَ، وَأَنا مُديرُ الشَّرِكَةِ هُنا.
dialogue.tr: intaqalati sh-sharika ilā Judda, wa anā mudīru sh-sharika hunā
dialogue.en: The company moved to Jeddah, and I am the company manager here.
dialogue.ur: Company Jeddah muntaqil ho gayi, aur main yahan company ka manager hoon.

dialogue.en: You were happy in Iraq.
dialogue.ur: Aap Iraq mein khush the.

dialogue.ar: هَذا صَحيحٌ، العِراقُ بَلَدٌ جَميلٌ، وَلي أَصْدِقاءُ هُناكَ.
dialogue.tr: hādhā ṣaḥīḥ, al-ʿIrāqu baladun jamīl, wa lī aṣdiqāʾu hunāk
dialogue.en: That is true. Iraq is a beautiful country and I have friends there.
dialogue.ur: Yeh sahi hai, Iraq ek khoobsurat mulk hai aur wahan mere dost hain.

dialogue.en: What do you think of Jeddah?
dialogue.ur: Jeddah ke bare mein aapki kya raay hai?

dialogue.tr: Juddatu madīnatun kabīratun wa jamīlatun jiddan
dialogue.en: Jeddah is a big and very beautiful city.
dialogue.ur: Jeddah ek bada aur bohat khoobsurat shehar hai.

dialogue.en: How do you spend your time in Jeddah?
dialogue.ur: Aap Jeddah mein waqt kaise guzarte hain?

dialogue.ar: أَذْهَبُ مَعَ الأُسْرَةِ إِلى شاطِئِ البَحْرِ.
dialogue.tr: adhhabu maʿa l-usra ilā shāṭiʾi l-baḥr
dialogue.en: I go with the family to the seaside.
dialogue.ur: Main ghar walon ke saath samundar ke kinare jata hoon.

dialogue.en: And where are you going now?
dialogue.ur: Aur ab aap kahan ja rahe hain?

dialogue.ar: أَذْهَبُ إِلى مَكَّةَ لِلْعُمْرَةِ وَالصَّلاةِ في المَسْجِدِ الحَرامِ.
dialogue.tr: adhhabu ilā Makka lil-ʿumra wa ṣ-ṣalāti fī l-Masjidi l-Ḥarām
dialogue.en: I am going to Makkah for Umrah and to pray in the Sacred Mosque.
dialogue.ur: Main Umrah aur Masjid-e-Haram mein namaz ke liye Makkah ja raha hoon.

dialogue.en: How long does the trip to Makkah take?
dialogue.ur: Makkah ka safar kitni der leta hai?

dialogue.en: It takes about one hour.
dialogue.ur: Takreeban ek ghanta lagta hai.

options: The company moved to Jeddah / Company Jeddah muntaqil hui
He was unhappy / Woh naakhush tha
He wanted to study / Woh parhna chahta tha
He had no friends / Uska koi dost nahi tha

q.ur: "Shehar" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني مَكانًا كَبيرًا يَسْكُنُهُ كَثيرٌ مِنَ النّاسِ؟

q.en: Where does Harith go for Umrah?
q.ur: Harith Umrah ke liye kahan jata hai?
q.ar: إِلى أَيْنَ يَذْهَبُ الحارِثُ لِأَداءِ العُمْرَةِ؟

q.en: How long is the trip to Makkah?
q.ur: Makkah ka safar kitni der ka hai?

options: About one hour / Takreeban ek ghanta

intro.en: Layth asks Thamir where he came from, when, and why. Notice حَضَرْتُ (I came) and the answer «حَضَرْتُ لِلدِّراسَةِ» (I came to study).
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein Layth, Thamir se poochta hai ke woh kahan se aaya, kab aaya aur kyun aaya. حَضَرْتُ (main aaya) aur jawab «حَضَرْتُ لِلدِّراسَةِ» (main parhne aaya) par dhyan dein.
intro.ar: يَسْأَلُ لَيْثٌ ثامِرًا: مِنْ أَيْنَ حَضَرْتَ؟ وَمَتى؟ وَلِماذا؟ لاحِظْ كَلِمَةَ «حَضَرْتُ» وَالجَوابَ «حَضَرْتُ لِلدِّراسَةِ».

dialogue.en: Where did you come from?
dialogue.ur: Aap kahan se aaye?

dialogue.en: I came from Yemen. I am Yemeni.
dialogue.ur: Main Yaman se aaya hoon. Main Yamani hoon.

dialogue.en: And when did you come from Yemen?
dialogue.ur: Aur aap Yaman se kab aaye?

dialogue.en: I came ten years ago.
dialogue.ur: Main das saal pehle aaya.

dialogue.en: Do you have Yemeni nationality?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap ke paas Yamani qaumiyat hai?

dialogue.tr: naʿam, wa maʿī jawāzu s-safari l-yamaniyy
dialogue.en: Yes, and I have a Yemeni passport.
dialogue.ur: Jee haan, aur mere paas Yamani passport hai.

dialogue.en: Did you come for work?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap kaam ke liye aaye?

dialogue.ar: لا، حَضَرْتُ لِلدِّراسَةِ، وَبَعْدَ الدِّراسَةِ تَزَوَّجْتُ.
dialogue.tr: lā, ḥaḍartu lid-dirāsa, wa baʿda d-dirāsati tazawwajtu
dialogue.en: No, I came to study, and after my studies I got married.
dialogue.ur: Nahi, main parhne aaya, aur parhai ke baad shaadi kar li.

dialogue.en: And what do you do here?
dialogue.ur: Aur aap yahan kya kaam karte hain?

dialogue.en: I am a professor at the university.
dialogue.ur: Main university mein ustad hoon.

dialogue.en: Do you visit Yemen?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap Yaman jate hain?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ، أَقْضي العُطْلَةَ مَعَ الأُسْرَةِ في اليَمَنِ.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, aqḍī l-ʿuṭla maʿa l-usra fī l-Yaman
dialogue.en: Yes, I spend the holiday with my family in Yemen.
dialogue.ur: Jee haan, main chhuttiyan ghar walon ke saath Yaman mein guzarta hoon.

dialogue.en: Are you happy here?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap yahan khush hain?

dialogue.en: Yes, praise be to Allah.
dialogue.ur: Jee haan, Alhamdulillah.

options: For a trip / Sair ke liye

intro.en: Ahmad asks Badr why he lives in a quiet village but works in the city. Learn words about the village (هادِئ, نَقِيّ) and the city (ضَوْضاء, تَلَوُّث, اِزْدِحام).
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein Ahmad, Badr se poochta hai ke woh gaon mein kyun rehta hai jabke kaam shehar mein karta hai. Gaon ke alfaaz (هادِئ, نَقِيّ) aur shehar ke alfaaz (ضَوْضاء, تَلَوُّث, اِزْدِحام) seekhein.
intro.ar: يَسْأَلُ أَحْمَدُ بَدْرًا: لِماذا تَسْكُنُ في قَرْيَةٍ هادِئَةٍ وَتَعْمَلُ في المَدينَةِ؟ تَعَلَّمْ كَلِماتِ القَرْيَةِ (هادِئ، نَقِيّ) وَكَلِماتِ المَدينَةِ (ضَوْضاء، تَلَوُّث، اِزْدِحام).

dialogue.en: Where do you live now, Badr?
dialogue.ur: Badr, aap ab kahan rehte hain?

dialogue.en: I live in the village.
dialogue.ur: Main gaon mein rehta hoon.

dialogue.en: Why did you leave the city?
dialogue.ur: Aapne shehar kyun chhora?

dialogue.en: The village is quiet and the air is clean.
dialogue.ur: Gaon pur-sukoon hai aur hawa saaf hai.

dialogue.ar: وَلَكِنْ في المَدينَةِ جامِعاتٌ، وَمُسْتَشْفَياتٌ، وَشَرِكاتٌ، وَأَسْواقٌ.
dialogue.tr: wa lākin fil-madīna jāmiʿāt, wa mustashfayāt, wa sharikāt, wa aswāq
dialogue.en: But in the city there are universities, hospitals, companies and markets.
dialogue.ur: Lekin shehar mein universities, hospital, companies aur bazaar hain.

dialogue.ar: وَفي المَدينَةِ أَيْضاً ضَوْضاءُ، وَتَلَوُّثٌ، وَازْدِحامٌ.
dialogue.tr: wa fil-madīna ayḍan ḍawḍāʾ, wa talawwuth, wazdiḥām
dialogue.en: And in the city there is also noise, pollution and crowding.
dialogue.ur: Aur shehar mein shor, aloodgi aur bheed bhi hai.

dialogue.ar: لِماذا تَسْكُنُ في القَرْيَةِ وَأَنْتَ تَعْمَلُ في المَدينَةِ؟
dialogue.tr: limādhā taskunu fil-qarya wa anta taʿmalu fil-madīna?
dialogue.en: Why do you live in the village when you work in the city?
dialogue.ur: Aap gaon mein kyun rehte hain jabke kaam shehar mein karte hain?

dialogue.en: There is no problem.
dialogue.ur: Koi masla nahi.

dialogue.en: How do you go to the city?
dialogue.ur: Aap shehar kaise jate hain?

dialogue.en: I go by train.
dialogue.ur: Main train se jata hoon.

dialogue.en: How long does the trip to the city take?
dialogue.ur: Shehar tak safar kitni der leta hai?

dialogue.tr: tastaghriqu sāʿatan wa niṣfa s-sāʿati taqrīban
dialogue.en: It takes about an hour and a half.
dialogue.ur: Takreeban derh ghanta lagta hai.

q.en: Why does Badr live in the village?
q.ur: Badr gaon mein kyun rehta hai?

options: It is quiet and the air is clean / Gaon pur-sukoon hai aur hawa saaf hai
It is near the sea / Samundar ke qareeb hai
It has many shops / Wahan bohat dukanein hain

q.ur: "Aloodgi" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى أَنَّ الهَواءَ غَيْرُ نَظيفٍ؟

q.en: How does Badr go to the city?

q.ur: "Bheed / traffic" ke liye kaun sa lafz?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني كَثْرَةَ السَّيّاراتِ وَالنّاسِ في المَدينَةِ؟

intro.en: Match each word with its plural: صَديق → أَصْدِقاء, شَرِكَة → شَرِكات, طِفْل → أَطْفال. Then match words with places: the village is quiet, the city has pollution and noise.
intro.ur: Har lafz ko uski jama se milayein: صَديق → أَصْدِقاء, شَرِكَة → شَرِكات, طِفْل → أَطْفال. Phir alfaaz ko jagah se milayein: gaon pur-sukoon hai, shehar mein aloodgi aur shor hai.
intro.ar: طابِقْ بَيْنَ كُلِّ كَلِمَةٍ وَجَمْعِها: صَديق ← أَصْدِقاء، شَرِكَة ← شَرِكات، طِفْل ← أَطْفال. ثُمَّ اخْتَرِ الكَلِماتِ المُناسِبَةَ لِلْقَرْيَةِ وَلِلْمَدينَةِ.

q.en: Which word belongs to the village?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz gaon se milta hai?

intro.en: Practise asking and answering with a friend: مَتى حَضَرْتَ مِنَ اليَمَنِ؟ – حَضَرْتُ قَبْلَ عَشْرِ سَنَواتٍ. Also كَمْ تَسْتَغْرِقُ الرِّحْلَةُ؟ – تَسْتَغْرِقُ ساعَةً واحِدَةً. Use لِماذا تَرَكْتَ…؟ and أَذْهَبُ مَعَ الأُسْرَةِ إِلى…
intro.ur: Dost ke saath sawal jawab ki mashq karein: مَتى حَضَرْتَ مِنَ اليَمَنِ؟ – حَضَرْتُ قَبْلَ عَشْرِ سَنَواتٍ. Aur كَمْ تَسْتَغْرِقُ الرِّحْلَةُ؟ – تَسْتَغْرِقُ ساعَةً واحِدَةً. Saath hi لِماذا تَرَكْتَ…؟ aur أَذْهَبُ مَعَ الأُسْرَةِ إِلى… istemal karein.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى السُّؤالِ وَالجَوابِ مَعَ صَديقِكَ: مَتى حَضَرْتَ مِنَ اليَمَنِ؟ – حَضَرْتُ قَبْلَ عَشْرِ سَنَواتٍ. وَكَمْ تَسْتَغْرِقُ الرِّحْلَةُ؟ – تَسْتَغْرِقُ ساعَةً واحِدَةً. وَاسْتَعْمِلْ: لِماذا تَرَكْتَ…؟ وَأَذْهَبُ مَعَ الأُسْرَةِ إِلى…

q.en: How do you ask "When did you come from Yemen?"
q.ur: "Aap Yaman se kab aaye?" kaise poochenge?
q.ar: أَيُّ سُؤالٍ يَسْأَلُ عَنْ وَقْتِ الحُضورِ مِنَ اليَمَنِ؟

options: I came ten years ago / Main das saal pehle aaya
I will come in ten years / Main das saal baad aaunga
I stayed ten days / Main das din raha
I left ten years ago / Main das saal pehle gaya

q.en: Which question asks about the duration of a trip?
q.ur: Safar ki muddat kaun sa sawal poochta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ سُؤالٍ يَسْأَلُ عَنْ مُدَّةِ الرِّحْلَةِ؟

q.en: Answer: كَمْ تَسْتَغْرِقُ الرِّحْلَةُ إِلى مَكَّةَ؟
q.ur: Jawab dein: كَمْ تَسْتَغْرِقُ الرِّحْلَةُ إِلى مَكَّةَ؟
q.ar: أَجِبْ: كَمْ تَسْتَغْرِقُ الرِّحْلَةُ إِلى مَكَّةَ؟

intro.en: Practise the sound ث (th), made with the tongue between the teeth. Listen and repeat the names: ثابِت، حارِث، لَيْث، ثامِر. Then do the listening drills.
intro.ur: Harf ث (th) ki awaz ki mashq karein, zubaan daanton ke beech rakh kar. Sunein aur naam dohrayein: ثابِت، حارِث، لَيْث، ثامِر. Phir sun kar samajhne ki mashqein karein.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى صَوْتِ حَرْفِ الثّاءِ (ث) وَيَخْرُجُ مِنْ بَيْنِ طَرَفِ اللِّسانِ وَالأَسْنانِ. اِسْتَمِعْ وَكَرِّرِ الأَسْماءَ: ثابِت، حارِث، لَيْث، ثامِر. ثُمَّ أَجِبْ عَنْ تَمارينِ الاسْتِماعِ.

q.ur: Kaun sa naam ث se shuru hota hai?
Kis naam ke aakhir mein ث hai?

q.en: Which name has ث in the middle?
q.ur: Kis naam ke beech mein ث hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ اسْمٍ فيهِ حَرْفُ الثّاءِ بَعْدَ الرّاءِ؟

options: حارِث (before the last letter / aakhri harf se pehle)

q.en: Which name has no ث at all?
q.ur: Kis naam mein ث bilkul nahi?
q.ar: أَيُّ اسْمٍ لَيْسَ فيهِ حَرْفُ الثّاءِ؟

intro.en: Answer questions about the family trip to Makkah: Who is in the car? Where is the family going? What will they do? Then practise dialogues like «مِنْ أَيْنَ حَضَرْتَ؟ – حَضَرْتُ مِنَ اليَمَنِ.» and «لِماذا حَضَرْتَ؟ – حَضَرْتُ لِلْعَمَلِ / لِلدِّراسَةِ / لِلْعُمْرَةِ / لِلْحَجِّ.»
intro.ur: Makkah ke khandani safar ke bare mein sawalon ke jawab dein: gaari mein kaun hai? Ghar wale kahan ja rahe hain? Phir «مِنْ أَيْنَ حَضَرْتَ؟ – حَضَرْتُ مِنَ اليَمَنِ.» aur «لِماذا حَضَرْتَ؟ – حَضَرْتُ لِلْعَمَلِ / لِلدِّراسَةِ / لِلْعُمْرَةِ / لِلْحَجِّ.» jaise mukalmon ki mashq karein.
intro.ar: أَجِبْ عَنْ أَسْئِلَةٍ حَوْلَ رِحْلَةِ الأُسْرَةِ إِلى مَكَّةَ: مَنْ في السَّيّارَةِ؟ إِلى أَيْنَ تَذْهَبُ الأُسْرَةُ؟ ماذا سَتَفْعَلُ؟ ثُمَّ تَدَرَّبْ عَلى حِواراتٍ مِثْلِ «مِنْ أَيْنَ حَضَرْتَ؟ – حَضَرْتُ مِنَ اليَمَنِ.» وَ«لِماذا حَضَرْتَ؟ – حَضَرْتُ لِلْعَمَلِ / لِلدِّراسَةِ / لِلْعُمْرَةِ / لِلْحَجِّ.»

options: I came for Umrah / Main Umrah ke liye aaya
I came for work / Main kaam ke liye aaya
I came for study / Main parhne aaya
I came from Umrah / Main Umrah se aaya

q.ur: Mukammal karein: حَضَرْتُ ____ العَمَلِ (kaam ke liye)
q.ar: أَكْمِلْ بِما يَدُلُّ عَلى السَّبَبِ: حَضَرْتُ ____ العَمَلِ

options: Where is the family? / Ghar wale kahan hain?
Who is the family? / Ghar wale kaun hain?
Is the family happy? / Kya ghar wale khush hain?
How is the family? / Ghar wale kaise hain?
Whether the family is happy / Ghar wale khush hain ya nahi
The family's age / Ghar walon ki umar
The family's work / Ghar walon ka kaam
The family's food / Ghar walon ka khana

intro.en: Read the paragraph about Thabit in Jeddah, then answer yes or no. Read another paragraph about Abdul Aziz, a Kenyan student in Makkah, and answer the questions.
intro.ur: Thabit ke bare mein paragraph parhein jo Jeddah mein rehta hai, phir haan ya nahi mein jawab dein. Phir Abdul Aziz ke bare mein paragraph parhein, jo Kenya ka talib-e-ilm hai aur Makkah mein parhta hai, aur sawalon ke jawab dein.
intro.ar: اِقْرَأْ فِقْرَةً عَنْ ثابِتٍ في جُدَّةَ ثُمَّ أَجِبْ بِـ«نَعَمْ» أَوْ «لا». ثُمَّ اقْرَأْ فِقْرَةً أُخْرى عَنْ عَبْدِ العَزيزِ، طالِبٍ كِينيٍّ في مَكَّةَ، وَأَجِبْ عَنِ الأَسْئِلَةِ.

options: In Umm al-Qura University in Makkah / Makkah ki Jamia Umm al-Qura mein
options_ar: في جامِعَةِ أُمِّ القُرى في مَكَّةَ

q.ur: Abdul Aziz ki qaumiyat kya hai?

q.en: Where does Abdul Aziz pray Asr, Maghrib and Isha?
q.ur: Abdul Aziz Asr, Maghrib aur Isha kahan parhta hai?
q.ar: أَيْنَ يُصَلّي عَبْدُ العَزيزِ العَصْرَ وَالمَغْرِبَ وَالعِشاءَ؟

options: Arabic language and Islamic culture / Arabi zubaan aur Islami saqafat

intro.en: Join letters to make words, put scrambled letters and words in order, fill the blanks, and copy the plurals: شَرِكات، جامِعات، مُسْتَشْفَيات. Finish with colours and plural words.
intro.ur: Haroof jorr kar lafz banayein, bikhre hue haroof aur alfaaz ko tarteeb dein, khali jagahein bharein aur jama alfaaz naqal karein: شَرِكات، جامِعات، مُسْتَشْفَيات. Aakhir mein rang aur jama alfaaz ki dohrai karein.
intro.ar: صِلِ الحُروفَ لِتُكَوِّنَ كَلِماتٍ، وَرَتِّبِ الحُروفَ وَالكَلِماتِ المُبَعْثَرَةَ، وَأَكْمِلِ الفَراغاتِ، وَانْسَخِ الجُموعَ: شَرِكات، جامِعات، مُسْتَشْفَيات. ثُمَّ راجِعِ الأَلْوانَ وَالجُموعَ.

q.en: Choose the right word: أَذْهَبُ إِلى شاطِئِ ____
q.ur: Sahi lafz chunein: أَذْهَبُ إِلى شاطِئِ ____
q.ar: اخْتَرِ الكَلِمَةَ الصَّحيحَةَ: أَذْهَبُ إِلى شاطِئِ ____

q.ur: "Mahine" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
